svg.title: Three ways to run API Connect
svg.desc: Three ways to run API Connect: SaaS hosted on AWS, as Pay-as-you-Go, Standard or Premium; a single-tenant Reserved Instance hosted on IBM Cloud; software, self-managed on premises, in a hybrid cloud or multi-cloud. IBM sets each plan by annual API call volume, instances, analytics retention and SLA.
